name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
October 25, 2022
6:30
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1-7)
1.
CITY COUNCIL ACTION MINUTES
a)
Minutes of October 11, 2022 Special Meeting
b)
Minutes of October 11, 2022 Regular Meeting
Recommendation:   Review and Approve.
Minutes
2.
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTERS
Recommendation:   Review and Approve Warrant Register(s) of October 25, 2022.
Warrant Register Approval - 25 OCT 2022
3.
ADOPTION ON SECOND READING, BY TITLE ONLY, ORDINANCE NO. O22-758 AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES AMENDING CHAPTER 9.20: UNLAWFUL POSSESSION OF A CATALYTIC CONVERTER OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES.
Recommendation: (1) present, on second reading, by title only; and (2) adopt proposed Ordinance No. O22-758: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES AMENDING CHAPTER 9.20: UNLAWFUL POSSESSION OF A CATALYTIC CONVERTER OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES.
3 - Staff Report
4.
RECEIPT AND FILING OF FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE PERIOD ENDING AUGUST 31, 2022
Recommendation: Receive and File.
4 - Staff Report
5.
PLANNING COMMISSION ACTIONS OF OCTOBER 18, 2022
Recommendation: Receive and file.
5 - Planning Commission Actions of 10-18-2022
6.
CONSIDERATION OF (1) ADOPTION OF PROPOSED AMENDMENT NO. 3 TO CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES AGREEMENT WITH TRAVERS TREE SERVICE INC. FOR CITYWIDE TREE TRIMMING AND MAINTENANCE SERVICES IN AN AMOUNT OF $222,000, FOR A TOTAL REVISED NOT TO EXCEED AGREEMENT AMOUNT OF $497,000; (2) ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION 22-XX ESTABLISHING THE BUDGETARY AUTHORITY FOR CONTRACT AMENDMENT NO. 3
Recommendation: Approve Amendment No. 3 to City of Palos Verdes Estates Agreement with Travers Tree Service, Inc. (Travers) for citywide tree trimming and maintenance services in an amount of $220,000, for a total revised not to exceed agreement amount of $497,000 and Adopt Resolution 22-XX Establishing the Budgetary Authority for Contract Amendment No. 3
6 - Staff Report
7.
RECEIVE AND FILE THE ADDITIONAL FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 BUDGET ASSESSMENTS AND ADOPTION OF A PROPOSED RESOLUTION APPROVING BUDGET TRANSFERS WHICH EXCEED $10,000.
Recommendation: (1) receive and file additional Final Fiscal Year 2021-22 (FY 22) Budget Adjustment and adopt a proposed resolution approving budget transfers which exceed $10,000.
7 - Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARING
8.
NC-1745-21 and M-1548-22; NEIGHBORHOOD COMPATIBILITY AND MISCELLANEOUS APPLICATIONS FOR A REMODEL AND ADDITION TO AN EXISTING SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE AT 760 VIA DEL MONTE. LOT 12, BLOCK 1537, TRACT 6884.
Recommendation: Adopt City Council Resolution No. R22-XX approving Neighborhood Compatibility and Miscellaneous applications at 760 Via Del Monte.
8 - Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
9.
REVIEW AND ADOPTION OF ONE-TIME REVENUES AND GENERAL FUND SURPLUS POLICY FOR THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES
Recommendation: Review and Adopt a One-time Revenues and General Fund Surplus Policy.
9 - Staff Report
9 - Staff Report Revised
10.
INTRODUCTION ON FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE 22-XXX AMENDING TITLE 15 (BUILDINGS AND CONSTRUCTION) OF THE PALOS VERDES ESTATES MUNICIPAL CODE BY ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE 2022 CALIFORNIA BUILDING, RESIDENTIAL, ELECTRICAL, MECHANICAL, PLUMBING, ENERGY, GREEN BUILDING, HISTORICAL BUILDING AND EXISTING BUILDING CODES; THE 2022 CALIFORNIA REFERENCED STANDARDS, THE 2021 INTERNATIONAL PROPERTY MAINTENANCE CODE; THE 2021 UNIFORM SWIMMING POOL, SPA, AND HOT TUB CODE; AMENDING CHAPTER 8.12 (FIRE CODE) OF TITLE 8 (HEALTH AND SAFETY) OF THE PALOS VERDES ESTATES MUNICIPAL CODE BY ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE 2020 LOS ANGELES COUNTY FIRE CODE, RATIFYING THE MORE RESTRICTIVE BUILDING STANDARDS CONTAINED IN THAT CODE, AND DELEGATING ENFORCEMENT OF THE FIRE CODE IN THE CITY TO THE FIRE CHIEF; AND AMENDING CHAPTER 13.14 (“SANITARY SEWER AND INDUSTRIAL WASTE”) TO TITLE 13 (PUBLIC SERVICES) OF THE PALOS VERDES ESTATES MUNICIPAL CODE TO ADOPT BY REFERENCE THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SANITARY SEWERS AND INDUSTRIAL WASTE ORDINANCE (TITLE 20, DIVISION 2 – LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE)
Recommendation: 1) Approve the first reading and introduction of an ordinance entitled “AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES AMENDING TITLE 15 (BUILDINGS AND CONSTRUCTION) OF THE PALOS VERDES ESTATES MUNICIPAL CODE BY ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE 2022 CALIFORNIA BUILDING, RESIDENTIAL, ELECTRICAL, MECHANICAL, PLUMBING, ENERGY, GREEN BUILDING, HISTORICAL BUILDING AND EXISTING BUILDING CODES; THE 2022 CALIFORNIA REFERENCED STANDARDS, THE 2021 INTERNATIONAL PROPERTY MAINTENANCE CODE; THE 2021 UNIFORM SWIMMING POOL, SPA, AND HOT TUB CODE; AMENDING CHAPTER 8.12 (FIRE CODE) OF TITLE 8 (HEALTH AND SAFETY) OF THE PALOS VERDES ESTATES MUNICIPAL CODE BY ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE 2020 LOS ANGELES COUNTY FIRE CODE, RATIFYING THE MORE RESTRICTIVE BUILDING STANDARDS CONTAINED IN THAT CODE, AND DELEGATING ENFORCEMENT OF THE FIRE CODE IN THE CITY TO THE FIRE CHIEF; AND AMENDING CHAPTER 13.14 (“SANITARY SEWER AND INDUSTRIAL WASTE”) TO TITLE 13 (PUBLIC SERVICES) OF THE PALOS VERDES ESTATES MUNICIPAL CODE TO ADOPT BY REFERENCE THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SANITARY SEWERS AND INDUSTRIAL WASTE ORDINANCE (TITLE 20, DIVISION 2 – LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE)"; and 2) Set a public hearing date of November 22, 2022 for adoption of said Ordinance
10 - Staff Report
11.
DISCUSS AND APPROVE OR PROVIDE GUIDANCE TO REFINE A PROPOSED SCOPE OF WORK FOR INCLUSION IN AN ENTERPRISE RESOURCE PLANNING (ERP) SOFTWARE SELECTION AND IMPLEMENTATION PROJECT MANAGER REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
Recommendation: Discuss and approve or provide guidance to refine a proposed scope of work for inclusion in an ERP software selection and implementation project manager RFP.
11 - Staff Report
MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
Tentative Agenda Items
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 8, AT 6:30 P.M.
